enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Anarchic Burst 3: This weapon is a chaotic conduit, dealing 3d6 Chaos damage on a successful hit to Lawful enemies, and 7d6 Chaos damage on a critical hit to Lawful enemies. This effect makes the weapon chaotically aligned.Lawful characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.

Paralyzing 45: Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a DC 45 Will save or be paralyzed. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the paralysis lasts for 1 minute.
Anarchic 3: On Hit: 3 to 12 Chaos damage. Chaos-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Lawful user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.

Elasticity: This bow is strung with special fibers that cause it to occasionally launch arrows with shocking force. When rolling a 19 or 20 on a ranged attack, your critical multiplier is increased by +1.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
